title: Courtesy Transportation Agreements: Condition, Key, Damage and Deposit Amounts
content:
Fee schedule of the cashier's office for Courtesy Transportation Agreements, covering the vehicle-condition fees, the key fob fee, the damage deductible and the card hold placed at issue. All amounts are in US dollars.

| Program | Cleaning fee | Smoking fee | Pet hair fee | Lost key fob fee | Damage deductible (most the customer owes) | Card hold at issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 75.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 350.00 | 500.00 | 100.00 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 75.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 350.00 | 500.00 | 200.00 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 100.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 375.00 | 500.00 | 200.00 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 125.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 450.00 | 1000.00 | 250.00 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 100.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 375.00 | 500.00 | 200.00 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 125.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 450.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 |

## Schedule notes

- **Cleaning fee**: the fee for a loaner returned needing more than ordinary cleaning.
- **Smoking fee**: the fee for smoking in the loaner.
- **Pet hair fee**: the fee for pet hair removal.
- **Lost key fob fee**: the fee for a lost or unreturned key fob.
- **Damage deductible**: the most the customer owes for damage to the loaner during the agreement.
- **Card hold at issue**: the card authorization hold placed when the loaner is issued; 0.00 means no hold is placed.

## Comparing the programs

- The smoking fee (250.00) and the pet hair fee (150.00) are the same in every program.
- The Courtesy Loaner - SUV and the Fleet Replacement Unit carry the highest cleaning fee (125.00), lost key fob fee (450.00) and damage deductible (1000.00).
- The Fleet Replacement Unit shows a card hold of 0.00, so no card hold is placed for that program; every other program places one, from 100.00 for the Same-Day Courtesy Loaner to 250.00 for the Courtesy Loaner - SUV.

## Reading the damage deductible: hypothetical figures

The deductible is a ceiling on what the customer owes for damage during one agreement. Under a Courtesy Loaner - Midsize agreement, if the damage on a hypothetical repair estimate came to 1800.00, the customer would owe no more than 500.00 for that damage on that agreement. The estimate is invented for the example.
